# Recorded pending declarations

The two-release training audit identified 17 blank early declarations and no subsequently filled blank. A separate operational question is whether an explicitly pending declaration later acquires a substantive label. The early snapshot contains the literal publisher strings `Copyright Not Evaluated` and `Copyright Undetermined`. Before examining the destinations of transitions from those states, define the training feasibility check as follows.

Use the same IDs, snapshots and training-only partition as the blank-field audit. Define pending as either of the two strings above. Keep a valid later object with a nonblank label outside both pending categories. Measure how many eligible training objects acquired an explicit Public Domain declaration, how many acquired another substantive label, how many independent accession groups these changes span and how many had a sibling with a substantive declaration at the earlier date. Also count all objects still pending, blank or absent from the valid later export. An accession key without a parseable group forms a singleton for cluster counts. This is an observed transition in a publisher's metadata, conditional on an eventual decision. It does not determine what would happen to indefinitely pending cases. Future predictors must use the earlier snapshot only and exclude rights fields beyond the fact of eligibility.
